name: file-parse
description: Parse a document (CSV, PDF, HTML, image, ICS, XML, plain text, or Markdown). Pass content_base64 or a temp_file_url, the reported mime_type, and filename. Always pass filename from the download tool or from archive-extract. When mime_type is missing or application/octet-stream, the filename extension selects the parser (.xml, .txt, .md, .markdown, .csv, .pdf, .html, .htm, .ics, and image extensions). A specific mime_type wins over the extension. extract_as structures the result; raw XML, text, Markdown, CSV, and ICS need no model call.

inputs.content_base64: string? (base64-encoded file content — required unless temp_file_url is provided)
inputs.temp_file_url: string? (file:// URL pointing to a temp file on disk — alternative to content_base64; use the temp_file_url returned by ceo-inbox-download-attachment or email-download-attachment)
inputs.mime_type: string? (reported MIME type, e.g. 'text/csv', 'application/pdf', 'image/jpeg', 'text/html', 'text/calendar', 'application/xml', 'text/xml', 'text/plain', 'text/markdown', 'text/x-markdown', 'application/octet-stream'. Pass what the download tool reported, even when it is application/octet-stream.)
inputs.filename: string? (original filename with its extension — always pass this. The download tools and archive-extract both return it. Required for .md, .txt, and .xml attachments that arrive as application/octet-stream. Ignored when mime_type is a specific type.)
inputs.extract_as: string? (optional extraction schema hint; defaults to 'raw'. Known schemas with tailored prompts: 'receipt', 'bank_statement', 'invoice'; 'calendar_invite' on ICS returns deterministic invite fields. Use 'raw' to skip LLM structuring. Any other non-empty string (e.g. 'purchase_order', 'business_card') triggers a generic extraction prompt using the schema name as a hint.)

outputs.structured: object (extracted fields per extract_as schema; null when extract_as is 'raw' or omitted)
outputs.confidence: number (0–1 confidence in the extraction; 1.0 for deterministic CSV parsing)
